messages:
anya (docs): Heads-up: I opened a docs PR to consolidate our function/tool-calling examples and introduce the `envelope` pattern for structured outputs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/498

rahul (eng-runtime): Nice. Quick spec question — are we standardizing on `status: OK|ERROR` or a lowercase `status: ok|error`? Consistency matters for SDK helpers.

anya (docs): Going with lowercase `ok/error` to match other payloads. Proposed shape: `{\n  \"status\": \"ok|error\",\n  \"result\": <object|null>,\n  \"error\": <{code: string, message: string}|null>\n}`

jess (devex): Can we add Node + Python snippets showing validate-with-schema pattern? Also swap any `eval()` usages to safe parsing. I'll add a lint rule note.

anya (docs): Yup added both. Example (Node):
```js
const resp = await client.callTool('summarize', {text});
if (resp.status !== 'ok') throw new Error(resp.error.message);
const payload = schemaValidate(resp.result, summarySchema);
```

mike (eng-ml): One more thing — include a short note about streaming: when reconstructing chunks, run a schema check after join. Otherwise partial JSON from truncation can silently pass.

rahul (eng-runtime): Agreed. Also recommend `max_tokens` bump on retry and a parse-fallback endpoint example.

anya (docs): Added "robust parsing" section: reassemble stream -> try parse -> if fails, try incremental backoff + higher max_tokens -> final fallback: call parse-helper tool.

jess (devex): I left comments about old link to parser-v1; there's one anchor we should update. Can someone run a quick link-check before merge?

link-bot: Link-check queued. Will report failures on PR.

mike (eng-ml): Minor: update guardrails paragraph to include arrays of unions (we've seen malformed union entries). Won't block though.

rahul (eng-runtime): I'll run a tiny SDK smoke test once links and evals are fixed. If green, will approve.

anya (docs): Thanks all. Checklist in PR: replace eval(), add parse-fallback examples, streaming integrity note, update links. Hoping to merge today. :rocket:
